sources.summary: CasaLuna is located on a 2,650 m² coastal plot in Playa Bonita, Las Terrenas. The longitudinal configuration of the site establishes a central axis that organizes the ground floor into two perimeter volumes articulated by an interior courtyard. This strategy favors cross-ventilation, the entry of natural light, and visual continuity toward the Atlantic Ocean.
